title: Software Architecture & Delivery Basics — D6
purpose: Shows the documented internals needed to predict behavior; undocumented details are observed behavior and may change.
routing_rationale: Direct manual deployments to production are forbidden. Code changes must pass automated testing in Cloud Build, generate cryptographically signed image digests in Artifact Registry, and promote via Cloud Deploy canary gates.

groups.label: Google Cloud CI/CD Perimeter (Cloud Build & Deploy)

nodes.label: Developer Git Repo
nodes.detail: Trunk-based branch with signed commits triggering automated webhooks.

nodes.label: Cloud Build Trigger
nodes.detail: Listens for push events; launches isolated build workers in Google VPC.

nodes.label: Artifact Registry
nodes.detail: Stores immutable, SHA256-verified OCI container images with vulnerability scan.

nodes.label: Cloud Deploy Pipeline
nodes.detail: Manages declarative release promotion across dev, staging, and production.

nodes.label: GKE Production Cluster
nodes.detail: Runs containerized microservices behind autoscaling pods and load balancers.

steps.title: Commit Trigger
steps.action: Developer merges pull request; webhook notifies Cloud Build.
steps.why_traversal: Automates pipeline execution without manual developer credentials.

steps.title: Hermetic Container Build
steps.action: Cloud Build executes hermetic compilation and pushes image to Artifact Registry.
steps.why_traversal: Produces immutable digest (sha256:...) ensuring provenance integrity.

steps.title: Release Declaration
steps.action: Artifact Registry triggers Cloud Deploy to create release target manifest.
steps.why_traversal: Enforces separation of concerns between build phase and release rollout.

steps.title: Canary Rollout
steps.action: Cloud Deploy orchestrates 10% canary traffic shift onto GKE cluster.
steps.why_traversal: Verifies real user latency and error budgets before 100% promotion.

scenarios.label: Critical Vulnerability Intercept
scenarios.root_cause: Automatic vulnerability scanning detects critical CVE-2026-1029 in base image.
scenarios.diverted_path: Artifact Registry blocks release promotion; Binary Authorization signature is withheld.
scenarios.blast_radius: Build is stopped in CI; production workloads remain untouched.
scenarios.recovery: Base image is patched in Git repo; automated pipeline re-runs to clear scan.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
